svg.text: Kimi KDA K2 on NVIDIA B300: where the time goes
Real Nsight Systems + Nsight Compute evidence · CUDA 13.0 · CC 10.3 · 148 SM · measured 2026-09-01
A. Nsight Systems — last captured GPU iteration (T=4096, H=12, BF16)
B. Value slicing trades per-CTA size for whole-GPU coverage
C. Peak resources remain unsaturated after slicing
Fastest case still uses only 26.4% SM and 11.3% DRAM throughput
D. Scheduler and cache evidence — global coverage ≠ per-SM occupancy
V16 is faster although achieved occupancy falls: it activates 96 CTAs across the GPU instead of only 12.
K2 dominates the trace; slicing raises CTA/SM coverage; compute and HBM stay far below peak; scheduler idle time remains high.
⇒ Primarily issue/latency + CTA-distribution bound — not a traditional Tensor Core compute roof or HBM bandwidth roof.
Reproducible source: k2_nsys_timeline.csv · k2_nsys_ranges.csv · k2_ncu_metrics.csv · make_bottleneck_figure.py
